text: Figure 4.28: Overview of communication attributes of PPortPrototype As explained before, ComSpec meta-classes which are required on the level of a SwComponentType are attached to the PortPrototype declarations which in turn are part of the deﬁnition of a SwComponentType. Nevertheless, the usage of Com- Specs is not restricted to the PortPrototypes of AtomicSwComponentTypes (for more details please refer to section 2.5). Sections 7.5.1 and 7.5.2 then explain the sender-receiver and client-server communi- cation patterns with respect to the RTE, the RTE events and the corresponding com- munication attributes. 117 of 566 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 062: AUTOSAR_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate
